notes: Sonoma County has few public 24/7 YouTube cameras: two civic cameras answered oEmbed on verified_at, so the region leans on Caltrans District 4's keyless HLS traffic video (cwwp2.dot.ca.gov open data lists each camera's wzmedia.dot.ca.gov playlist; only playlists that answered #EXTM3U on verified_at are listed, and a camera's stream goes dark during maintenance).
